What is Notion AI?

AI layer inside the Notion workspace. It searches across your Notion content plus connected apps, drafts and edits documents in place, fills database properties automatically, and runs autonomous agents over your workspace.

Best for

Answering questions and automating writing inside a workspace you already maintain in Notion.

Main features

  • AI writing and editing inline in any page
  • Enterprise Search across Notion, Slack, Google Drive, GitHub, Jira and more
  • AI database properties (auto-summarise, categorise, extract) that update as rows change
  • Notion Agents running multi-step workspace tasks
  • AI Meeting Notes with transcription
  • Research Mode producing sourced reports
  • custom AI connectors.

Practical use cases

  • Asking a question and getting an answer sourced from your company wiki
  • auto-summarising every row in a customer-feedback database
  • transcribing and summarising a meeting straight into a project page
  • drafting a PRD from scattered notes.

Who is it for?

  • Teams already running their wiki, docs and project tracking in Notion; startups, product and ops teams.

Pricing, free access & limits

Included in Business and Enterprise plans; add-on for lower tiers

Plans described in the source

Notion Free $0 (limited AI trial responses). Plus around $12/user/mo annually ($14 monthly) - AI available as a paid add-on. Business around $24-30/user/mo annually with Notion AI included. Enterprise custom, annual. Notion restructured in 2025 to bundle AI into Business rather than sell it as a universal $8-10 add-on, which materially raised the effective price for teams that wanted AI on Plus.

Free plan

The free workspace includes an AI trial allowance, rather than confirmed ongoing free AI access. Yes - Notion Free includes the workspace with a limited AI trial allowance.

Free trial

Yes - Business trials offered; free AI responses on the free tier act as a sampler.

Usage limits to consider

Free tier gives a small number of trial AI responses. AI usage is subject to fair-use limits rather than hard counts on paid tiers. Enterprise Search connector availability varies by tier.

Strengths & tradeoffs

These points summarize the supplied research, rather than hands-on test results.

Strengths noted in the source

  • AI where the content already lives, with no export or context-pasting
  • AI database properties are a genuinely novel automation primitive
  • Enterprise Search across connected apps is strong
  • meeting notes landing directly in the relevant project page removes a real workflow gap.

Limitations to consider

  • The 2025 repackaging pushed AI into the $24+ Business tier, a significant cost increase for small teams
  • AI quality is good but not frontier-level
  • it only knows what is in Notion, so value collapses if your organisation's knowledge lives elsewhere
  • performance degrades on very large workspaces
  • limited control over which model is used.

Platforms, languages & integrations

Platforms

  • Web, Windows, macOS, iOS, Android, Chrome extension

Languages

  • Interface in 15+ languages; AI output multilingual including Arabic and French

API access

Yes - Notion API (the API does not expose all AI features)

Integrations and exports

  • Slack, Google Drive, GitHub, Jira, Confluence, Figma, Zoom, Microsoft Teams, Zapier, Make

Evaluation notes

The value is entirely proportional to how disciplined your Notion workspace already is - AI over a messy workspace returns messy answers. Price the Business tier for the whole team, not just AI users, since Notion licenses per seat.
